extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (NordVPN, PIA, Custom, ProtonVPN)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for LibreELEC. Supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), ProtonVPN via Custom Mode, and Custom configurations. Features an automated Systemd watchdog to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for LibreELEC. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news: v1.5.6 (17-10-2026) - Added generic internet infrastructure pre-flight check (gateway, physical interface, kernel MTU, system nameservers) usable by all VPN providers - Added universal TCP/ICMP latency probe shared across providers in providers/routing.py - NordVPN: per-server latency ranking, fastest endpoint written first so failover chain tries optimal nodes first - NordVPN: slow endpoints deferred in ranking order instead of being silently dropped, guaranteeing no data loss on degraded regions - NordVPN: country name map persisted between sessions for profile matching without hardcoded values - PIA: speed profiler now uses shared ICMP probe for consistent measurements across all providers - PIA: top ranked node IPs logged for diagnostics, optimal node remains pinned at pool index zero - PIA: graceful fallback when probe times out, slow servers rank lower instead of crashing pipeline - Mullvad: relays ranked by measured endpoint latency before config generation - Mullvad: unreachable relays sorted to back of candidate list instead of blocking pipeline - Failover chain (sibling retry logic) automatically traverses ranked candidates from fastest to slowest - Infrastructure check is purely diagnostic: updates succeed even on degraded networks, ranking adapts gracefully
